text:
The latest GitHub release of filamentphp/filament is v5.9.0, published 2026-09-26T19:40:26Z.

Release notes:

## New Features
* feat: Add strict hierarchical breadcrumbs option by @ahmed-rashad-alnaggar in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20153
* Add Rich Editor block icons, grid layout, search, and sticky controls by @imliam in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20448
* Add minimal custom block controls to the Rich Editor by @imliam in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20449
* Add search to Builder block picker by @KianAcquoy in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20469
* Allow customizing the table filters reset action by @devhoussam1998 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20476
* fix: Resolve nested resource index URLs to parent relation pages by @OccTherapist in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20479
* feat(actions): add `enum()` to `ImportColumn` by @MadBox-99 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20482
* Feature: nested action parent data by @webard in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20502
* feat: add button size helper to ToggleButtons component by @getupkid in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20517
* Feature: full-width toggle buttons by @caseydwyer in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20520
* feat: add rich content faker by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20537
* feat: Add Markdown faker by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20558
* Add opt-in CSP nonce support for scripts by @m-develops in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20301
* Add table content render hooks by @mortalkiller in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20566
* feat: import testing helpers by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20560
* feat: export testing helpers by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20562

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump WyriHaximus/github-action-get-previous-tag from 2.0.0 to 2.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20540
* chore(deps): bump WyriHaximus/github-action-get-previous-tag from 2.0.0 to 2.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20541
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.3 to 0.6.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20543
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.3 to 0.6.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20544
* Fix incorrect `InvalidArgumentException` import in `HasRecordActions` by @ukeloop in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20555
* fix: ensure heading levels are at least 1 by @ukeloop in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20556
* chore: remove unused imports by @ukeloop in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20557
* fix: scope null relationship groups without bypassing filters by @people-sea in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20563
* fix: fail with an install hint when a make command needs a panel and none are registered by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20568

## New Contributors
* @m-develops made their first contribution in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20301
* @SulimanAbdulrazzaq made their first contribution in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20568

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/compare/v5.8.4...v5.9.0
